about: Hunter step 5's pitfall creatures, where live has them, by the pits: spined larupias in the Feldip Hunter area, horned graahks in the Karamja Hunter area, sabre-toothed kyatts in the Rellekka Hunter area, sunlight antelopes in the Avium Savannah and moonlight antelopes in the Burrow under the Hunter Guild. Each tile and type is the creature's OSRS Wiki page (its location table). Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: the wild broav (While Guthix Sleeps).
